package.description: InfluxDB is a time series database designed to handle high write and query loads.

en-US.description: InfluxDB is a time series database designed to handle high write and query loads.
en-US.longDescription: It is an integral component of the TICK stack. InfluxDB is meant to be used as a backing store for any use case involving large amounts of timestamped data, including DevOps monitoring, application metrics, IoT sensor data, and real-time analytics.
en-US.name: InfluxDB OSS
